terms.definition: The gland behind the stomach that makes digestive enzymes and blood-sugar hormones.
terms.function: Helps digest food and control blood sugar.
terms.whyItMatters: It connects digestion and blood-sugar balance.

terms.definition: The enzyme-rich liquid the pancreas sends to the small intestine.
terms.function: Breaks down proteins, fats, and carbs.
terms.whereItIs: Made in the pancreas, used in the small intestine.
terms.whyItMatters: It finishes the chemical breakdown of food.

terms.definition: A hormone from the pancreas that controls blood sugar.
terms.function: Signals cells to take sugar from the blood.
terms.whereItIs: Made in the pancreas, travels in the blood.
terms.whyItMatters: It keeps blood sugar steady and fuels cells.

terms.definition: A chemical messenger made by a gland and carried in the blood.
terms.function: Signals cells in another part of the body.
terms.whereItIs: Released into the blood from glands.
terms.whyItMatters: Hormones like insulin coordinate body functions.
